name: iphone-duo-skills
title_zh: 折叠 iPhone 上写 App：铰链、竖条
tagline_zh: iPhone Duo 还没到手，适配问题先来了：铰链姿态怎么读、竖向外屏那一条怎么排、展开后两个场景怎么分。
tagline_en: Before the foldable iPhone ships, you already have layout questions: hinge state, the narrow cover bar, two.
desc_en: Agent skills for building iOS apps on iPhone Duo, Apple's first foldable iPhone — adaptive layout, vertical bars, hinge & scenes, camera, and design review.
why_zh: 不套用 iPad 的 size class 糊弄过去，而是按铰链角度和场景状态分别给布局决策。
why_en: Doesn't fake it with iPad size classes — it branches layout on hinge angle and scene state, and treats the narrow cover bar as.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 iPhone Duo 这一形态：没有真机或对应模拟器时铰链与场景状态只能靠猜；普通 iPhone。
limit_en: Covers only the iPhone Duo form factor: without the device or matching simulator, hinge and scene states are guesswork; non-foldable iPhone/iPad.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Build iOS apps for Apple's foldable iPhone Duo
